evidence.name: Screen field: Left, center, or right text
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Left, center, or right text" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Left, center, or right text
sections.description: Sets whether the text reads from the Left, Center, or Right. Center suits short headlines and call-to-action lines, while Left is easier to read for longer body copy. (Left and right follow language direction and flip on right-to-left locales.)
